content.study:
Section 43C — Composition of Council

Section 43C provides for the composition of the Arbitration Council of India and the statutory categories of its Chairperson and Members.

Part IA provisions concerning the Arbitration Council of India must be read with the commencement and implementation status of the relevant provisions and subordinate legislation.
